b: And I don’t mean this in the way you think (speaking to the senior devs here).

Why waste a day designing and normalizing a schema by hand when you can give an LLM a five-minute level 2 C4 diagram, the app's operations, the role separation, and have it produce a prototype schema, an ERD, and 3NF normalization?

With modular monoliths at the app level, the database’s isolation level will inevitably change when the user-base scales anyway, so immediately adding something like Flyway instead of worrying about getting it right the first time seems like a very intelligent thing to do.
I know there’s some anal people out there who will pour fuel to this fire, but what do I actually get from doing it manually these days?
